_description: Primary Language Curriculum (2019) — English strand outcomes. TF codes with stage progression.

outcomes.label: Social conventions and awareness of others
Playful and creative use of language
Conventions of print and sentence structure
Phonics, word recognition, and word study
Conventions of print and sentence structure

TF4.C1: play with, recognise, and manipulate sounds to develop phonological and phonemic awareness
TF4.C2: use phonological and phonemic awareness to decode and encode words
TF4.C3: use a range of word identification strategies flexibly
TF4.C4: use a comprehensive range of word identification strategies fluently

TF5.C1: recognise, name, and sound all lower-case and upper-case letters and identify common sounds
TF5.C2: use phonic knowledge and a range of word identification strategies to read unfamiliar words
TF5.C3: use phonic knowledge and a range of word identification strategies with flexibility and confidence
TF5.C4: read widely and use a full range of word identification strategies flexibly and automatically

TF9.C1: recall and talk about significant events and details in a text
TF9.C2: recall and discuss the main events, information, or ideas in a text
TF9.C3: retrieve, interpret, and integrate information from a range of texts
TF9.C4: synthesise, and critically evaluate information from a wide variety of texts

TF10.C1: read short, structured texts at an appropriate pace with understanding
TF10.C2: read a range of texts accurately and with understanding at an appropriate pace
TF10.C3: read a range of texts accurately, fluently, and with expression
TF10.C4: read a wide range of challenging texts fluently, accurately, and with expression

TF4.C1: use approximate spelling based on developing knowledge of letter-sound relationships
TF4.C2: spell a range of high-frequency words and use phonetic strategies to attempt unfamiliar words
TF4.C3: spell a wide range of words accurately using a range of spelling strategies
TF4.C4: spell accurately and use spelling resources effectively

TF9.C1: develop a satisfactory and legible style of handwriting
TF9.C2: use a clear and legible handwriting style, developing fluency and speed
TF9.C3: use a fluent, legible, and joined handwriting style
TF9.C4: produce legible, fluent, and efficiently-presented handwritten text
